 UPSC Announces Recruitment Results For September 2026; Check List Of Recommended Candidates
 The Union Public Service Commission said several recruitment cases were finalised in September, with recommended candidates informed individually.
 Representational Image ( ANI ) By ETV Bharat English Team 
 Published : October 21, 2026 at 2:17 PM IST 
 | Updated : October 21, 2026 at 3:15 PM IST 
 2 Min Read New Delhi: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) on Wednesday announced the September 2026 recruitment results and stated that several recruitment cases have been finalised during the month.
 The commission said recommended candidates have been informed individually by post. According to UPSC, applications from other candidates were also duly considered. However, they could not be shortlisted for interviews or recommended for the respective posts.
 The 17 recruitment selections cover several positions across different ministries and departments. For the post of Scientist-B (Documents), six candidates: Ashutosh Sharma, Sandeep Kumar Pathak, Sumit, Ankit Tripathi, Vijayant Kumar and Sangita Biswas, were recommended for the Central Forensic Science Laboratory under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 For Assistant Director Grade-I under the Indian Economic Development Service (IEDS), recommendations were issued for five specialisations under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME). These included 11 candidates for Chemical, 17 for Food, 11 for Hosiery, 10 for Leather and Footwear, and two for Metal Finishing. For Assistant Director Grade-II (IEDS), three candidates were recommended for Chemical, four for Food, three for Hosiery and one for Leather and Footwear.
 For the post of Assistant Professor in History, Navaneeth Krishnan S and Uthara K were recommended for Jawahar Lal Nehru Rajkeeya Mahavidyalaya in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The recruitment results also covered lecturer positions in Zoology and Urdu under the Ladakh School Education Department, with eight candidates recommended for Zoology and 14 for Urdu.
 The selections further included Associate Professor positions in Electrical Engineering (Energy System) and Civil Engineering (Environmental Engineering) at the College of Military Engineering in Pune. The finalised recruitment results also covered Consultant Biochemistry and Consultant Forensic Specialist posts under Ladakh's Department of Health and Medical Education.
